EffectsPanel.SettingShowDisabledEffectsHint: If enabled, disabled effects will be shown in the panel with a grey tint.
EffectsPanel.SettingShowPassiveEffectsHint: Controls when passive (non-temporary) effects are shown in the panel. 'If Always Visible' respects each effect's 'Show Icon?' setting.
EffectsPanel.SettingShowDurationOverlaysHint: If enabled, an overlay icon will be shown over each effect to indicate its duration.
EffectsPanel.SettingSeparateTemporaryAndPassiveHint: If enabled, temporary and passive effects will be separated by a horizontal line in the panel.
EffectsPanel.SettingIconSizeHint: This defines the size of the icons in the effects panel.
EffectsPanel.SettingDoubleClickBehaviorHint: This defines the behavior when double-clicking an effect. Shift+double-click always opens the effect sheet.
EffectsPanel.SettingRightClickBehaviorHint: This defines the behavior when right-clicking an effect.
EffectsPanel.SettingShiftRightClickBehaviorHint: This defines the behavior when shift right-clicking an effect.
EffectsPanel.SettingAllowRightClickHint: This defines the minimum permission level to execute the right-click and double-click behavior on an effect. Setting this to None will never allow these actions.
EffectsPanel.SettingViewPermissionHint: This defines the minimum permission level to see the effects panel. Setting this to None will never show the effects panel.
EffectsPanel.SettingViewDetailsPermissionHint: This defines the minimum permission level to see the details of the effects in the panel such as the duration and description. Setting this to None will never show any details.
EffectsPanel.ItemEffectProtected: This effect originates from an item and cannot be deleted. It has been toggled instead.
